newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemen offers spot crude for sale in fourth quarter.
newsitem.headline: Yemen offers spot crude for sale in fourth quarter.

text.p: Yemen has invited bids for spot crude sales in the fourth quarter of the year after some term customers rejected contract prices for the period.

Yemen's crude marketing directorate offered Marib Light and Masila crude in separate or combined lots of 600,000, one million, 1.6 million and two million barrels for October, November and December, a statement from the Ministerial Board for Marketing of Crude Oil (Yemen) in Sanaa said.
Yemen cut fourth quarter Brent-related term prices after Asian and European buyers complained they were too high after Middle East benchmark Dubai lost value versus Brent.
But traders said some buyers have declined to accept the new offer, leaving crude available, particularly for October.
Yemen exports about 100,000 barrels a day (bpd) of Masila and 30,000 bpd of Marib Light to Japanese, South Korean and European buyers.
